before: A record that sets no width (a cell alignment) on the cell a removed column took width from held the cell's width from before that column as its original, or showed the cell wider than the grid, and a fold moved a lent width record after the alignment, which then hid it.
after: Compose draws the record's original lent too and the removed column's own cell as inserted, so the engine's resolve gives the width back to the cell and to its record; a fold keeps a moved lent width in the order the records were made.
reason: Change messages, the change log, the manifest fields and the Yjs format do not change: every client composes the same table from the same items, and the checkpoint attribute is one the format already has. A room admits only clients of its own code version.
